memory_candidates.content: Measuring axiom dependence in a Lean development where [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] is the normal baseline: a 'choice-free' claim must be measured with #print axioms, never assumed. Two traps measured in the BimodalLogic tree: (1) a general reflection/symmetry law whose proof opens with eq_or_ne (classical excluded middle) pulls in Classical.choice, while its off-zero/strict half is [propext] alone -- route a strict case through the off-zero law instead; (2) le_of_add_le_add_left pulls in Classical.choice where sub_nonpos.mpr plus add_sub_cancel_left is choice-free. A corollary pattern: rw often cannot see through a reducible wrapper (F.TaskRel) to the underlying pattern of the off-zero lemma, so a four-line binder-free wrapper theorem is needed for the rewrite to fire even though the term-level application succeeds.
